project_type: Python FastAPI API + Temporal worker + Next.js 16.3.7 App Router dashboard — monorepo
build_system: uv workspaces (api, worker, packages/synthetiq-shared); dashboard uses npm. `uv sync --all-packages` installs everything. `npm ci` in dashboard/.
test_framework: pytest (api/tests/); no test runner configured in worker. Dashboard: `npm run build` is the verification gate.
build_command: uv sync --all-packages (Python); cd dashboard && npm ci && npm run build (dashboard)
verification_instructions: 1. Python: `uv sync --all-packages` then `cd api && python -m pytest tests/ -x -q`. 2. Migration: `cd packages/synthetiq-shared && alembic upgrade head`. 3. Dashboard: `cd dashboard && npm run build`. 4. Import smoke: `python -c 'from src.main import app'` inside api/. 5. Worker import: `python -c 'from src.flows.workflows import MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow'` inside worker/src/.
environment_constraints: Windows dev machine (PowerShell). Do NOT restart any running dev server. Alembic.ini is at repo root c:\Users\HP\SynthetIQ\alembic.ini but migrations live at packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic/. Run alembic from packages/synthetiq-shared/. Next.js 16.3.7 — read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before any new dashboard code.
contribution_requirements: dashboard/AGENTS.md: read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any dashboard code. App Router conventions apply (file-system routes, 'use client' for interactive components, page.tsx as default export).
key_patterns: API routes: APIRouter + require_permission() + TenantCtx dependency. Worker: Temporal @workflow.defn + @workflow.signal + ApplicationError. Dashboard: 'use client' page.tsx, MUI v5, service class (BaseService subclass in app/lib/services/), hook (useXxxService in app/lib/hooks/useServices.ts), types in app/lib/types/. Sidebar nav items in components/AppSidebar.tsx NAV_ITEMS array with roles[] filter. Alembic migrations: revision/down_revision chain, try/except around RLS for SQLite compat.
directory_structure: repo root: api/ (FastAPI), worker/ (Temporal), packages/synthetiq-shared/ (ORM models + Alembic), dashboard/ (Next.js), .github/workflows/, deploy/. Shared models in packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/models/organization.py (WorkflowRun is here, NOT in a separate models/runs.py for the ORM class). Alembic migrations at packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic/versions/. API tests at api/tests/. Worker factories at worker/src/factories/.
